sections.overview: Pterinochilus murinus is an African tarantula in the family Theraphosidae, known in the pet trade as the orange baboon tarantula.
sections.identification: The World Spider Catalog recognizes it as a valid species in the African genus Pterinochilus.
sections.habitat: An atlas records it in South Africa’s savanna biome. Its broad range spans several regions of Africa, so it has no single typical habitat.
sections.diet: Species-specific prey information was not detailed in the references consulted.
sections.behavior: The sources consulted give little detail on species-specific behavior.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted do not provide a reliable species-specific summary of reproduction.
sections.ecology: Its distribution extends from Angola and central Africa through eastern Africa to southern Africa.
sections.conservation: No global conservation assessment was identified in the taxonomic and regional sources consulted.
